name: The BP engine
covers: Block, head, timing belt, water pump, gaskets and seals, sensors on the engine, the front drive and alternator, the compression, leak-down and service work

name: Gearbox and driveline
covers: The Miata 5-speed, clutch, flywheel, pilot and release bearing, the clutch pedal, master and line, the shifter against the tunnel, the gearbox crossmember, the driveshaft

name: Fuel system
covers: Everything from the tank to the rail; its parts sit in the three sub-zones

name: Cooling
covers: Radiator, electric fan and shroud, thermostat, expansion tank and its level switch

name: Intake
covers: Cold-air box and duct, filter, the tube to the throttle body, the IAT boss, the PCV fresh-air port, the throttle cable from the FB pedal

name: Exhaust
covers: The BP manifold, downpipe and flex, the converter and both O2 bungs, the 2.5 in pipe, muffler and hangers

name: Engine mounts
covers: The BP side brackets, adapter plates to the FB crossmember, the rubber mounts, where the engine sits (set back and low)

name: Engine wiring leg
covers: The BP leg from the ECU at the dash to every engine device, with the plugged turbo spares; designed with 02-electrical

name: Oil system
covers: Pan and pickup against the FB crossmember, filter access, the pressure sender and its plugged turbo-feed tee, the plugged turbo-return bung in the pan

name: Fuel tank
covers: The tank and its top opening for the pump (DS12), the vent, the EVAP canister and purge line

name: Fuel pump
covers: The Walbro 255 in the tank, its feed wire and soft fuse (HO12)

name: Fuel lines
covers: Feed and return from the tank to the rail, the filter, the old return check valve, the BP rail and its regulator fittings

name: Coolant hoses
covers: Upper and lower radiator hoses, heater hoses to the FB core, the bypass, the optional rear-outlet reroute
